questions.title: Which senior Trump administration official will CBS News report as visiting Moscow in August 2026?
questions.background: The United States has pursued diplomatic engagement with Russia concerning the war in Ukraine.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: CBS News reporting published during August 2026 identifying a senior Trump administration official as visiting Moscow.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the official explicitly named in that reporting as being in Moscow, rather than merely considering or planning a visit. The question concerns the identity reported by CBS News; independent verification or government confirmation of the visit is not required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The official's full name.

questions.title: Which U.S. state will report the country's first measles death of 2026?
questions.background: Measles can cause fatal complications, and state health departments monitor and report deaths associated with the disease.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official state health department announcements, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting from reliable news organizations.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the state that publicly reports a measles death among its residents occurring in calendar year 2026 and identified as the first reported U.S. measles fatality of that year. Resolution occurs when that announcement is made.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the U.S. state.
questions.accepted_format: The name of the U.S. state.

questions.title: What immigration status will the Trump administration seek to require for noncitizens to be included in the 2030 US census?
questions.background: The decennial US census affects representation in the House of Representatives and the allocation of federal funding. Trump has previously advocated changing which immigrants are counted.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official Department of Commerce proposal, or reliable contemporaneous reporting explicitly describing its eligibility rules for the 2030 census.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve upon the administration's next formal proposal specifying eligibility for the 2030 census, provided it is published by September 30, 2026. Identify the immigration status the proposal requires noncitizens to hold to be included. Publication is sufficient; implementation or judicial approval is not required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the required immigration status, in one to three words.
questions.accepted_format: The name of the required immigration status, in one to three words.

questions.title: Which U.S. state will be the first to settle its lawsuit against TikTok over youth-safety claims?
questions.background: TikTok faces lawsuits from U.S. states alleging that its platform harms young users and misleads consumers about its safety protections.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official announcements from state attorneys general, supported by reliable contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the U.S. state that reaches the first publicly announced settlement agreement with TikTok resolving a state lawsuit over youth safety and allegedly misleading safety claims. The agreement must be announced by September 30, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the U.S. state.
questions.accepted_format: The name of the U.S. state.

questions.title: Which federal appeals court will next rule that state gambling laws apply to Kalshi’s event contracts?
questions.background: Kalshi offers contracts tied to the outcomes of real-world events. Federal appeals courts have reached conflicting conclusions about whether these contracts are subject to state gambling laws.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Published federal appeals court decisions, corroborated by reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution Condition: Identify the first federal circuit court of appeals to issue a ruling after August 31, 2026, holding that states may apply their gambling laws to Kalshi’s event contracts.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the federal appeals circuit.
questions.accepted_format: The name of the federal appeals circuit.

questions.title: Which U.S. state will ask a court to halt further development of ChatGPT over safety concerns in September 2026?
questions.background: ChatGPT is OpenAI’s conversational AI service. State authorities can seek court orders restricting products they allege pose risks to consumers.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official state court filings or announcements by state authorities, corroborated by reliable news reporting.
  • Qualifying Event: During September 2026, a U.S. state formally asks a court to stop OpenAI from further developing ChatGPT until safety safeguards are established. The request itself resolves the question; the court need not grant it.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the U.S. state making the request.
questions.accepted_format: The name of the U.S. state making the request.

questions.title: Which court, if any, will grant Christa Pike a stay on the day of her scheduled September 30, 2026 execution?
questions.background: Christa Pike is on Tennessee's death row for the 1995 killing of Colleen Slemmer.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Use the court's order or contemporaneous reporting to identify the court.
  • Resolution Date: Resolve to the court that grants a stay of Pike's execution on September 30, 2026, before her scheduled execution time that day.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with its commonly used short name.
questions.accepted_format: Answer with its commonly used short name.
